cupertino.notes: ROUND 65: the Cupertino slider is now 190 px wide so it fits its cell, and the keyboard ring is the runtime's ring on a rounded 28 px box, closed on all four sides; viewed in the re-rendered PNG. Round 63 (z): derived from the platform's public design rules, not compared with a real screen or a capture. A two-thumb slider on the iOS slider's metrics: 4 px track, the accent between two 28 px white round thumbs with a hairline and a soft shadow. 25 to 75 of 0 to 100 at rest, hover and pressed, keyboard focus, disabled, stepped and touching.
gaps: iOS has no two-thumb slider (macOS neither): the thumbs reuse UISlider's size, the lit part runs between them
Hover and pressed draw nothing different from rest, as on the single Cupertino slider
No label beside the slider
